holder-quote: [Spiritguard Deflection]. I could probably block one of Chein’s punches. Just one, mind you. But it recharges pretty fast and it works with my clipboard.
effect-quote: The [Secretary] spun, and her clipboard hit the cup.

holder-quote: Sometimes, Salii wished she had the power to just—fight.
Salii ducked a jet of wind, and then her body started moving for her. She raised her clipboard—
effect-quote: —And knocked down a punch from a surprised [Sparkfist]!
